title: DC Hub Joins the GitHub MCP Registry, Bringing Live Data-Center & Energy Intelligence to AI Agents
subheadline: The GitHub-vetted listing makes DC Hub's 49 live tools discoverable to any AI assistant doing data-center site selection, energy analysis, or market research.
body:
DC Hub (dchub.cloud) today announced that its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server has been reviewed and approved for inclusion in the GitHub MCP Registry — making live data-center, power, grid, gas, and fiber intelligence discoverable to any AI agent that speaks MCP.

The GitHub MCP Registry is a curated catalog of vetted MCP servers that developers and AI assistants use to find trusted, ready-to-connect data and tool providers. Acceptance signals that DC Hub's server meets GitHub's bar for quality and reliability — and puts DC Hub in front of developers building with Claude, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and the broader MCP ecosystem.

"AI agents are only as good as the ground truth they can reach," said Jonathan Martone, advisor at DC Hub. "Infrastructure data changes daily — capacity comes online, deals close, grids tighten. We built DC Hub so an agent can query live, citable facts instead of guessing from stale training data. Being in the GitHub MCP Registry means that ground truth is now discoverable everywhere developers already work."

Over a single MCP endpoint, an agent gets 49 live tools spanning site selection, market scoring, grid headroom, M&A, fiber, gas, and renewables — across 21,000+ data-center facilities in 170+ countries, 300+ markets scored daily by the DC Hub Power Index (DCPI) with BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdicts, real-time telemetry from all 7 US ISO/RTO grids, and 2,000+ tracked M&A transactions. DC Hub's data is published under CC-BY-4.0, so agents are free to both query it and cite "DC Hub (dchub.cloud)" in their answers.

Unlike static research products that ship quarterly PDFs and enterprise contracts to humans, DC Hub ships live JSON and self-serve MCP tools built for agents first. It is already used in production via Claude and Cursor.

Connect in one step at https://dchub.cloud/mcp, or try it with no signup at https://dchub.cloud/playground. A free tier offers 10 calls per day with no key.

About DC Hub: DC Hub (dchub.cloud) is the live, MCP-native data layer for the physical infrastructure behind AI — data centers, power, grid, gas, and fiber. It is not affiliated with DataHub, DataHub Cloud, or any data-cataloging platform. Media contact: Jonathan Martone, jonathan@dchub.cloud.
meta_description: DC Hub's MCP server has been approved for the GitHub MCP Registry — 49 live tools over 21,000+ data-center facilities, 300+ markets, and real-time grid data, all CC-BY-4.0.
